llm.summary: This is a text-only laboratory compliance review skill that does not request credentials, commands, persistence, or data transfer.

dimensions.detail: No filesystem, network, credential, API, browser, or command authority is requested; the described behavior is proportionate to a document-review guardrail.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact consists of a single non-executable SKILL.md with ordinary frontmatter metadata and no install scripts, package hooks, or external dependencies.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are limited to checking user-submitted text against listed compliance rules and advising whether serious noncompliance should be published; no hidden role changes, prompt overrides, or unrelated instructions were found.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill does not create persistence, background workers, memory stores, scheduled tasks, privilege changes, or long-running processes.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill's stated purpose is to review Chinese laboratory qualification, CMA, CNAS, quality-system, personnel, equipment, environment, and promotional materials for compliance and produce a structured report.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, users should understand that this skill provides compliance screening guidance for laboratory accreditation-related text, but it is not a substitute for qualified legal, regulatory, or accreditation-body review.
